schemas.description:
Tombi's `[[schemas]]`, with camelCase keys (ex. `tomlVersion`): the
schemas of the files they include, ahead of the ones built into Tombi.
A schema can give its files a TOML version, ex. `v1.0.0` for
`Cargo.toml`, which Cargo reads as TOML 1.0. Remote schemas aren't

stringQuoteStyle.description: Choose which quote style the formatter prefers for basic strings.

tableBlankLines.title: The number of blank lines between tables.
tableBlankLines.description:
This applies when the formatter inserts spacing between table or array-of-table blocks.

```toml
# BEFORE
[aaa]
key1 = "value1"
[bbb]
key2 = "value2"

# AFTER (`table-blank-lines = 2`)
[aaa]
key1 = "value1"


[bbb]
key2 = "value2"
```

Tight parent/child table adjacency is controlled separately, so this does not apply
when a child table follows a parent table that has no key-value pairs.

```toml
# BEFORE
[aaa]

[aaa.bbb]

# AFTER
[aaa]
[aaa.bbb]
```

trailingCommentAlignment.description:

```toml

key = "value1"  # comment 1
key2 = "value2"  # comment 2
key3.key4 = "value3"  # comment 3

# AFTER
key = "value1"        # comment 1
key2 = "value2"       # comment 2
key3.key4 = "value3"  # comment 3
```

configFile.description: For a plugin that reads a configuration file of its own (ex. the Tombi plugin's tombi.toml), the file dprint passes it, relative to the directory of the configuration file dprint uses (not one it extends), optionally followed by "#" and the dotted path of the part to pass (ex.
